scientific_role: Prospective secondary comparator ladder for the separately frozen Eigen-JEPA real-market confirmation. It does not alter the parent study's full-versus-no_memory primary hypothesis, effect threshold, bootstrap, or claim boundary.
primary_question: Do simple covariance estimators match or outperform Eigen-JEPA on the same purged real-market test windows when every baseline hyperparameter is selected on validation data only?

selection.within_family_rule: Choose the candidate with lowest mean validation top-k eigenspectrum NMSE independently within each predeclared family.
selection.tie_rule: Stable candidate-grid order; no test metric may break a tie.

evaluation.folds: exactly the parent protocol's purged F1/F2/F3 expanding-window folds
evaluation.context_horizon_rank: exactly the frozen final-rigor v2 context_len, horizon, and k used by the parent runner
evaluation.headline_comparator_metric: pooled top-k eigenspectrum NMSE constructed from retained per-window eig_sq_error and target_energy
evaluation.secondary_metric: covariance NMSE constructed from retained per-window cov_sq_error and cov_target_energy
evaluation.retention: retain selected spec, every validation score, and every chronological test-window error row

implementation.source_commit_rule: Bind one exact prospective source commit after review and before any baseline test-outcome access.

authorization_requirements: parent real-market protocol is separately FROZEN_PRE_OUTCOME_AUTHORIZED
parent normalized CSV and input receipt pass the existing hash checks
this baseline protocol is changed to FROZEN_PRE_OUTCOME_AUTHORIZED with execution_authorized=true before test evaluation
the exact baseline source commit is bound prospectively
no candidate, family, validation rule, fold, or metric is changed after test-outcome access
claim_boundary: These baselines are controls, not trading strategies. A baseline win weakens an Eigen-JEPA forecasting claim; an Eigen-JEPA win supports only comparative forecast evidence on the frozen ETF/date design. Neither outcome establishes trading alpha, economic profitability, causality, or broad cross-asset superiority.
